repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgae1jRRi8FRrTxaZL

Live readings for #34932 (slice 2 of #34818). They were taken on the slice 2 commits over `d947a93cf`. The head `cbb82b02c` is the same three commits over `e05445e4f`, and none of the 17 commits between those bases touches the flow designer.

Setup:
- Backend: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh`.
- Console: `ui/apps/console` under Vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`.
- Browser: Playwright at 1280×860, with `locale` set to `zh-CN` and to `en`.
- Data: a flow draft on `showcase_task` (record-after-create), staged with `PUT /meta/flow/…?mode=draft`. It has a decision `标记任务` with two out-edges, `截止在未来` (empty) and `手写条件` (`record.due_date > today()`).
- Script, flow and screenshots: the seat's project files, `objectstack-seat3/34818-live/slice2/` (`check.mjs`, `flow.json`, `zh-1`…`zh-7`, `en-1`…`en-7`, `zh.log`, `en.log`).

| Reading | zh-CN | en |
|---|---|---|
| Empty edge opens as rows (shot 1) | `条件 · 公式 · + 添加条件…` | `Condition · Formula · + Add a condition…` |
| Field list in the rows, in order | business fields first (`标题`, `项目`, … `同步错误`), then `创建人`, `更新时间`, `更新人`, `负责人`, `创建时间` | the same order in English |
| Built "截止日期 · 晚于 · 今天" in the rows (shots 1–2) | summary `1 个条件` | summary `1 condition` |
| Stored `e2.condition` | `{"dialect":"cel","source":"record.due_date != null && record.due_date > today()"}` | identical |
| Formula shows the same guard (shot 3) | `record.due_date != null && record.due_date > today()` | identical |
| Picker order (shot 3) | `record · 触发记录`, then `标题 · record.title`, `项目 · record.project` …; last are `组织 · record.organization_id`, `更新时间 · record.updated_at`, `创建时间 · record.created_at` | `Title · record.title` …; last are `Organization`, `Last Modified At`, `Created` |
| Back to rows | same single row, nothing rewritten | same |
| Hand-written `record.due_date > today()` (shot 4) | opens in the formula input unchanged. 按字段填写 keeps it there and reads `这个条件超出了按字段填写能表示的范围，请继续用公式编辑。` | `This condition goes beyond what the field rows can show. Keep editing it as a formula.` |
| Approval inserted on `标记任务 → 提醒` (shot 5) | out-edges `approve → 提醒` and `reject → 已驳回` (new end node), pills `通过` / `驳回` | `approve → 提醒` and `reject → Rejected`, pills `Approve` / `Reject` |
| Reject edge removed, then Problems (shot 6) | `审批「审批」没有「驳回」出边，做出这个决定后流程无处可走。请从它连出一条连线，并把审批分支设为「驳回」。` | `Approval "Approval" has no "Reject" connection, so after that decision the flow has nowhere to go. Draw a connection out of it and set its approval branch to "Reject".` |
| Click on that row (shot 7) | the approval node is selected and its inspector opens | same |

The two author-named edge pills (`截止在未来`, `手写条件`) stay as the author wrote them in both languages. Only an approval's outcome keywords are translated.
